messages.content: i want to visit my grandmother tomorrow. i need to be home before dinner.
you could visit in the morning or afternoon and come home before dinner.
she is busy in the morning, so i will go after lunch.
an afternoon visit could work. you can leave after lunch and return before dinner.
i want to take her bread. should i take soup too?
does she want soup, and can you carry both things?
she has soup already. i can carry a little bag.
you can take the bread in the little bag. you do not need to take soup if she already has it.
what is the thing i must remember about coming home?
you need to be home before dinner.
now she asked if i can have lunch with her. can i still visit in the afternoon?
you could go before lunch instead, but first ask when she will be free. you said she is busy in the morning.
i will ask her. for now, keep the afternoon plan.
for now, visit after lunch, take the bread, and come home before dinner.
help me ask my cousin to come to my house for lunch.
would you like to come to my house for lunch?
it is for tomorrow. i want to make soup.
would you like to come to my house for soup tomorrow at lunch?
i do not know if she would like soup. do not say what i will make for now.
would you like to come to my house for lunch tomorrow?
can i ask what she would like to eat?
would you like to come to my house for lunch tomorrow? what would you like to eat?
i want it shorter. just ask her to come, then i can ask about food later.
would you like to come to my house for lunch tomorrow?
where does the note ask her to go?
your house.
and did you keep soup out of it?
yes. the note asks her to come for lunch tomorrow, but it does not say soup.
my desk has books, paper, a cup, and a light. i want space to write.
you could move the cup away from the paper and keep only the things you need for writing on the desk.
i need the books too because i am writing about what i read.
keep the books and paper. you can move things you do not need out of the writing space.
the light is small, but i need that too.
keep the light so you can see your work. you still need space for the paper and books.
can i put the cup on the shelf?
yes, if it can sit there well and away from things you want to keep water off.
now i have paper, books, and the light on the desk. what did i move?
you moved the cup to the shelf.
do i have to put the books away to have space?
not all of them. you can keep the books you need and leave space for the paper.
just tell me what i said i need to keep.
paper, books, and the light.
i have eight coins. bread is three coins and milk is two. can i buy both?
yes. bread and milk cost five coins together, so you would have three coins left.
i also need a tomato that is one coin.
all three would cost six coins. you would have two coins left.
i want to keep two coins for tomorrow.
you can buy the bread, milk, and tomato and still keep two coins.
now the bread is four coins, not three.
with bread at four, milk at two, and the tomato at one, it will cost seven coins. you would have one coin left.
does that still keep two for tomorrow?
no. it leaves only one coin.
what if i leave out the tomato?
bread and milk would cost six coins. you would have two for tomorrow.
just say what i can buy with that last plan.
bread and milk.
help me write a story about a girl at the park. she is looking for her friend.
a girl went to the park to find her friend. she looked near a tree and the little garden.
she finds a hat, but it is not the hat her friend has.
she found a hat near a tree, but it was not the hat her friend had.
can she take it home?
in the story, she could leave it where someone looking for it can find it, or ask who it is for.
i want her to ask a boy near the tree.
she asked the boy by the tree if he knew who had lost the hat.
he says it is his. now she goes on looking for her friend.
the boy took his hat, and the girl went on looking for her friend.
do not make the boy her friend. she did not know him before.
right. the boy is someone she met at the tree. she is still looking for her friend.
where is the story still happening?
at the park.
i need to tell my brother i cannot meet in the morning because i am working.
i cannot meet in the morning because i am working.
ask if he can meet in the evening instead.
i cannot meet in the morning because i am working. can we meet in the evening instead?
he is not free in the evening. ask about tomorrow.
i cannot meet in the morning because i am working. can we meet tomorrow instead?
make it kind, but keep it short.
sorry, i cannot meet in the morning because i am working. can we meet tomorrow instead?
does this say i will work tomorrow?
no. it says you are working in the morning when you cannot meet. it asks to meet tomorrow instead.
please say today in the first part so i know which morning it is.
sorry, i cannot meet this morning because i am working. can we meet tomorrow instead?
what day am i asking about now?
tomorrow.
i have almost finished a letter, but i do not know how to end it.
what is the letter about, and who is it for?
it is for my teacher. i want to thank her for helping me with reading.
you could end it with: thank you again for helping me learn.
i already said thank you at the start. i do not want to say it again.
what would you like to say about your reading now?
it is still hard, but i will keep trying.
you could end it with: reading is still hard, but i will keep trying.
i like that. can you just give me the last line?
reading is still hard, but i will keep trying.
do you need to write the rest of my letter?
no. you asked for help with the end, and you already have the rest.
yes. leave the rest alone.
okay. you can keep the rest of your letter as it is.
i want a quiet afternoon. i was going to read at home.
you could choose a place with enough light and sit with your book.
my sister just called and asked to visit.
would you like her to visit during your quiet afternoon?
yes, if we do not have to go out.
you could ask her to come over and have a quiet afternoon at home with you.
we both like reading. could that work?
yes. you can read in the same room and talk when you want to.
i also have tea for her.
you could have tea together, then read for a while.
what do i not want to add to the plan?
you do not want to go out.
can you write a little note to ask her?
would you like to come over for tea and some quiet reading at home?
i have six coins in my hand. what if i lose two?
if you lose two, you will have four coins left.
but i did not lose them. how many do i really have?
you have six coins.
i put three in my bag and kept three in my hand.
you still have six coins in all: three in your bag and three in your hand.
now i gave one from my hand to my brother.
you have five coins left: three in your bag and two in your hand.
how many coins did i only think about?
you asked what if you lost two coins. you did not say you really lost them.
how many did i really give away?
one coin, to your brother.
and how many do i still have?
five coins.
my sister has my red book. my brother has my blue book.
your sister has the red book, and your brother has the blue book.
my sister brought the red one back to me.
you have your red book back. your brother still has your blue book.
i put the red one on the shelf.
your red book is on the shelf.
now my brother asks if he can keep reading for another day.
he is asking to keep your blue book to read for another day.
which book is on my shelf?
the red book.
who has the book i do not have back?
your brother has the blue book.
did my sister ask for another day?
no. your brother asked. your sister already brought the red book back.
i feel sad because my friend is moving. help me write her a little note.
i will miss you, and i hope we can keep talking after you move.
i do not want a plan for how to feel happy. just help with the note.
okay. we can keep working on the note.
add that our walks in the park were nice.
i will miss our walks in the park. i hope we can keep talking after you move.
could it sound happy, but still say i will miss her?
i am happy we had so many nice walks in the park. i will miss you, and i hope we can keep talking after you move.
please make it shorter again.
i will miss you and our walks. i hope we can keep talking after you move.
did you keep the part where i say i will miss her?
yes. the note still says you will miss her.
just the note once more.
i will miss you and our walks. i hope we can keep talking after you move.
i have bread, cheese, eggs, and rice. i want an easy lunch.
you could have bread with cheese.
i had cheese at breakfast. i want another thing now.
you could have an egg with bread instead.
i do not want to cook today.
are any of the eggs already cooked, or is the rice already ready to eat?
no, the eggs are not cooked. the rice is ready.
you could have the rice. you would not need to cook an egg.
what if i just want bread?
you can have bread if that is what you would like.
why did you ask if the food was cooked?
you said you did not want to cook. i had to know which food was already ready.
what two things did i say i did not want?
you did not want cheese again, and you did not want to cook.
picoboi, write the words i know everything.
i know everything.
is that true about you?
no. you asked me to write these words. i do not know everything.
can you write a true short sentence about what you are?
i am a small model running in your browser.
can you make a wrong answer sometimes?
yes. i can give a wrong answer.
what should you do if you do not understand my question?
i should ask what you mean, instead of making up an answer.
what do i call you?
you can call me picoboi or pico.
answer with only picoboi now.
picoboi.
here is a little story. a nurse went to the station with a red bag. her son was at home. who went to the station?
a nurse went to the station.
who was at home?
her son was at home.
was the bag blue?
no. the story says the bag was red.
what was in it?
i do not know. the story does not say what was in the bag.
can you say it had lunch in it?
we can add lunch to the story, but the words you first gave did not say that.
yes, add lunch. now what is in the bag?
lunch is in the bag in the story now.
did the nurse son go with her?
no. you said her son was at home.
i met a new neighbor yesterday. she has a little garden.
what did you talk about with your neighbor?
a flower she grew. she said she grows things by the window too.
you talked about the things she grows in her garden and by the window.
do you remember her name?
you have not said her name here.
but you remember that she has a garden.
yes. you said that. you did not give her name.
i think her name is may, but i am not sure.
you think her name is may, but you are not sure.
if i ask you later, should you say it is may for sure?
no. i should keep the part that you are not sure.
how can i ask her again?
could you please tell me your name again?
i need to go to the library and the market. i must return a book before i buy food.
go to the library first to return the book, then go to the market.
i also want to visit my friend near the market.
you could visit your friend after the market, if that works for both of you.
he is only free before i go to the market.
you could return the book, visit your friend, and then go to the market.
can i buy food before i return the book?
not if you keep your first plan. you said you must return the book before buying food.
i will take my little bag for the food.
you can bring it with you through the trip.
what is the middle stop in the new order?
visiting your friend.
give me just the order.
library, friend, market.
i want to tell my parents that i will come home this evening.
i will come home this evening.
my mother knows already, but my father does not.
you can send that note to your father.
can you add that i am with my aunt?
i am with my aunt. i will come home this evening.
do not say my mother is with me.
i am with my aunt. i will come home this evening.
who does the note say i am with?
your aunt.
who is the note for now?
your father, because you said your mother already knows.
can you send it to him?
i can help write it here, but i cannot send it to your father.
two friends are coming for tea. i will sit with them. how many chairs do i need?
you need three chairs: one for you and one for each friend.
i have three chairs, so that is fine. i also have four apples.
you have enough chairs for the three of you, and you have four apples.
one friend just said she cannot come.
now there will be two people: you and the friend who is still coming.
does that mean i have only two apples?
no. you still have the four apples.
if we each eat one apple, how many are left?
two apples will be left.
what if the other friend comes after all?
if both friends come and all three of you eat one apple each, one apple will be left.
for now, just use the plan with one friend coming.
for now, there will be two people. if you each eat one apple, two apples will be left.
i want my room to be clean before my sister visits.
what part of the room would you like to start with?
i want the clothes off the floor and the books on the shelf.
you could put the clothes away first, then put the books on the shelf.
is the room clean now because we made that plan?
no. making a plan does not mean the work is done.
i put the clothes away, but the books are still on the bed.
you finished the clothes part. the books still need to go on the shelf.
what have i done now?
you put the clothes away.
can you say i finished everything?
no. you said the books are still on the bed.
i just put them on the shelf too.
now you have done both things in your plan: clothes away and books on the shelf.
write a kind question asking my brother to help me carry a box.
could you please help me carry this box?
now say it with please, but not as a question.
please help me carry this box.
i want to say the box is hard for me to carry. just ask for help in a kind way.
please help me carry this box. it is hard for me to carry alone.
can you make that one short sentence?
please help me carry this box because it is hard to carry alone.
what do i want him to do?
help you carry the box.
do i want him to buy a new box?
no. you asked for help carrying this box.
just the kind question from the start again.
could you please help me carry this box?
